description: CMXM Cookie Consent — POPIA-first consent and tracking management for WordPress. By Steno.
changelog:
1.2.14 — Standalone GA4 Consent Mode v2

  • Add a Strict Gate / Google Consent Mode v2 (advanced) option for standalone GA4 Measurement ID services.
  • Default existing GA4 services to strict consent gating; opt-in required for v2.
  • Send Google consent defaults before eligible GA4 tags load, with preference updates.
  • Preserve GTM consent modes, Cookie Inventory, existing data and automatic GitHub updates.
